title: LoomSphere execution evidence record
description: Observed process evidence emitted by scripts/factory_execute.py for exactly one explicitly allowlisted validation check. This document records what one local process observed. It is not an approval, not an agent assertion, not a CI verdict, and not tamper-proof: a digest stored inside the same editable file does not authenticate that file. Consumers must treat the record as untrusted input that still requires a trusted execution environment.

artifactVersion.description: Version of this artifact format. Bump only with a migration note in .github/contracts/README.md.

artifactKind.description: Discriminator identifying this file as an execution evidence record.

executionId.description: Unique identifier for this single execution attempt.

producedAt.description: UTC timestamp at which the record was produced.

runner.description: Identity of the program that produced this record.

version.description: Runner version. Recorded so a consumer can detect format drift.

implementation.description: Repository-relative path of the runner implementation.

provenance.description: Classifies the evidence as observed process execution rather than an assertion.

check.description: The single allowlisted check this record describes. The argument vector is fixed by the runner and is never derived from caller input.

checkId.description: Allowlisted check identifier. This enum must stay in sync with the runner allowlist; unknown identifiers can never carry a result.

category.description: Kind of validation the check performs.

argv.description: Exact argument vector executed, as a list so no shell quoting can be reinterpreted.

displayCommand.description: Shell-quoted rendering of argv for human readability. Never re-executed.

workingDirectory.description: Repository-relative working directory the allowlist declares.

expectedExitCode.description: Exit status this check defines as success.

timeoutSeconds.description: Effective timeout used. A caller may only tighten the allowlisted default.

repository.description: Revision context observed with read-only git commands.

revisionSource.description: 'unavailable' means git could not be read; the revision is then simply unknown, never guessed.

commit.description: Full commit sha, or null when the revision is unavailable.

dirtyWorktree.description: True when the working tree had uncommitted changes at execution time; null when unknown.

process.description: Process facts captured by the runner. Exit status is a fact, not an acceptance-criteria claim.

exitCode.description: Observed exit status, or null when the process never produced one.

termination.description: 'exited' means the process produced an exit status; 'timeout' and 'launch-error' both mean it did not.

launchError.description: Bounded, redacted description when the allowlisted command could not start.

result.description: How the observed process facts map to this check's own expectation. A passing check does not prove that any acceptance criterion is satisfied.

kind.description: 'observed' means the runner captured process facts. 'not-run' is reserved for records that describe a check that never executed.

outcome.description: Whether the observed exit status matched the expected status. A timeout is never a pass.

outcomeRationale.description: Short, redacted explanation. Required for failed and inconclusive outcomes.

authority.description: Explicit statement that this record confers no authority. Every grant field is a constant false so an edited file cannot claim approval without also breaking its own verification.

limitations.description: What this record cannot establish. Always non-empty.

capturedStream.description: Digest and bounded redacted summary of one captured output stream. The summary is truncated, so absence of a string in it proves nothing about the full output.

truncated.description: True when the digests cover more bytes than the stored summary.
